overall_comparison.historical_to_first: Autonomous document completion improved, but the semantic graph disappeared and the generated document contained omissions and unsupported claims. First attempt fails quality.
overall_comparison.first_to_second: Graph persistence, specific fact retention, image provenance, citation locations, synthetic scope and audit-object honesty improved. Two provider-boundary facts moved out of the body into an omission notice, and meaningful semantic errors remain.
overall_comparison.historical_to_second: The old table-number leak and false conjunctive condition group are absent from a now-populated narrative graph. New graph statements still strengthen source meaning, so the graph is suitable as navigation requiring source inspection rather than executable logical truth.
overall_comparison.generalization: Eight small live stage cases show that active navigational schema handles formatting variants, supplied links and ambiguity more robustly than the earlier optional legacy-formal schema. This does not establish arbitrary-document, oversized-input, final-document or production-system accuracy.
overall_comparison.coverage: Do not compare baseline 37/38, first audit 0.98, second audit 0.88 and reviewer fact-presence counts as a numerical quality trend. The metrics have different denominators, methods and audited objects.
